item.title: Ask HN: If Social network is created today, what do you want to see?
item.summary: If someone has to create a social network today, what would you like to see in it? - TikTok/Instagram like engaging videos? - Twitter/Reddit like discussion panel - Your own public diary journal - or, Latest events happening across the world from your feed? Building one here - https://qocial.com and would love your feedback. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49226693 Points: 5 # Comments: 21
